  • Enum Constant Details

    • REBOOT_PERSISTENT

      public static final GoodReadOverlayManager.PersistenceType REBOOT_PERSISTENT
      The overlay is persistent to device reboots. Any type of data reset (enterprise or factory) will remove this configuration.

    • ENTERPRISE_RESET_PERSISTENT

      public static final GoodReadOverlayManager.PersistenceType ENTERPRISE_RESET_PERSISTENT
      The overlay is persistent to enterprise reset. Only a factory reset can remove this configuration.

    • FACTORY_RESET_PERSISTENT

      public static final GoodReadOverlayManager.PersistenceType FACTORY_RESET_PERSISTENT
